summary: Interleaved sequence ownership and stable merging of attention partials
implementation_scope: Host sequence/page mapping, causal dense or sparse partial attention, log-sum-exp reduction and head-major scatter; native kernels and transport are external

agent_guidance.use_when: Long KV sequences benefit from disjoint storage across ranks evaluating identical queries
agent_guidance.avoid_when: Short contexts or communication overhead outweigh memory and compute savings
provides: Balanced interleaved ownership and local page addresses
Stable normalized attention partials with global causal and sparse masks
Log-normalizer weighted reduction with explicit empty-shard handling
Host head-major combine-and-scatter for multiple queries
engine_supplies: Query/key projections, position transforms and state buffers
Disjoint complete key ownership and identical query/scale/selection semantics
Native attention kernels, collectives, completion and failure propagation
State remapping when partition count changes
preserve: Each selected visible key contributes exactly once
Match head/query/value geometry and normalization convention
Reject invalid nonempty partials and withhold failed output
adapt: All-gather normalizers with weighted reduce-scatter or another equivalent reduction

code_files.purpose: Sequence ownership, causal partial attention and stable head-major reduction

requires.hardware: Python 3.11+ and standard library for the host reference; distributed hardware is an engine choice
requires.model: Attention over disjoint key/value positions with a shared query, scale and selection
requires.workload: Dense or sparse causal attention; head scatter requires head count divisible by rank count

contract.input: Global positions and transformed queries/keys/values, or normalized per-rank outputs with log normalizers
contract.output: Local sequence/page addresses, attention partials or merged head-major output with global log normalizers
contract.ownership: Reference owns immutable result tuples; engine owns state, rank membership, buffers and collective lifetimes
contract.failure: Reject duplicates within a shard, geometry mismatches, NaN/+inf and all-empty global attention; engine verifies cross-rank completeness and disjointness
contract.core_boundary: Optional attention strategy; Core requires only ordinary request, resource, readiness and publication contracts

validation.host: Direct-softmax comparisons for dense/sparse causal masks, uneven/empty shards, page boundaries, extreme normalizers, head layout and invalid inputs
validation.native: Native attention, multi-device collectives and complete-model behavior remain unqualified
validation.performance: Unmeasured; the sharded KV fraction is not a claim about total engine memory or latency
